entities.summary: Iván Benito Ruiz Cuesta, more commonly known as Iván Ruiz, is a retired volleyball player from Cuba. A one-time Olympian (2000), he played as an outside hitter and won a gold medal with the Cuban men's national volleyball team at the 1999 Pan American Games in Winnipeg. He also helped Cuba win the gold medal at the 2001 World Grand Champions Cup in Japan. Iván Ruiz was a athletes & competitors from Camagüey (b. 1977-03-26, Camagüey).
